The Agricultural Mechatronics requirements share some courses with the closed list (MFGT 110, MFGT 71, MFGT 131, MFGT 132, CMA 74, WLD 151), but they also include many courses that are not on it (MFGT 111A/B, 112A/B, 113, 114, 130, WLD 150, EGN 2, and others). Several closed-list courses (MFGT 70, CMA 81, WLD 152) are absent. This suggests a different program, not a renamed one.
A reviewer should locate the Manufacturing Technology A.S. section elsewhere in the 2026-2027 Hartnell catalog PDF, or confirm whether Agricultural Mechatronics replaced it.
